glyph_origin: Originally 𫢁, ideogrammic compound (會意): 享 + 京, a temple and a tower – meaning "to sacrifice at a high place". During the Warring States period, 享 was omitted. In seal script, 尤 (“especially; even more”) is added to the right, signifying "high; to go to a higher place".
senses: (Hokkien) alternative form of 著 (“to need to; exactly; already; even; as soon as”)
